title: You Are Already a Magician
description: Visual companion to expansion-essay32 on Crowley's magical system.

scenes.title: The Definition of Magic
scenes.subtitle: Magic is the art and science of causing change in conformity with will.

scenes.title: The Systematic Discipline
scenes.subtitle: Aleister Crowley stripped magic to a systematic discipline of consciousness.

params.caption: Four limbs: asana, pranayama, dharana, dhyana, theurgy.

scenes.title: Liber Resh — Solar Adorations
scenes.subtitle: Four times daily, the aspirant faces the solar station.

scenes.title: Three Functions
scenes.subtitle: Three functions: reminder, relationship, and theurgic contact.

scenes.title: The Four Adorations
scenes.subtitle: The four adorations anchor the day in sacred structure.

scenes.title: Liber E — The Fourfold Training
scenes.subtitle: Asana, pranayama, dharana, dhyana — the indispensable foundation.

scenes.title: The Foundation
scenes.subtitle: The foundation is boring, physical, and non-negotiable.

scenes.title: Liber Astarte — Devotion
scenes.subtitle: Constant mindfulness of the Beloved in every moment.

scenes.title: Love as Magical Force
scenes.subtitle: Love as a directed energy transforms the lover into the beloved.

params.caption: Love transforms the lover into the beloved.

scenes.title: The Mass of the Phoenix
scenes.subtitle: The magician prepares the Cake of Light at sunset.

params.caption: The Cake of Light — the life-force offered.

scenes.title: Carrying the Sun Through Night
scenes.subtitle: The magician carries the sun's essence through the night.

params.caption: The magician carries the sun through night.

scenes.title: The Star Ruby — Circle and Point
scenes.subtitle: The circle is the body of Nuit. The point is Hadit.

params.caption: The circle is infinite space. The point is awareness.

scenes.title: The Union
scenes.subtitle: The magician is the union of space and point.

params.caption: The union — the Great Work realized.

scenes.title: Recognition
scenes.subtitle: The infinite never became finite. It learned how finitude appears.

params.caption: The infinite never became finite. It learned how finitude appears.
